# Antigravity fixtures

Real outputs of `agy` 1.5.18 captured on two Accounts (2026-11-26; Item ag-2): `stream-ok.jsonl` and `stream-tools-sandbox-deny.jsonl` (`--output-format stream-json`, the second with a `git push` ended in tool ERROR by the deny rule), `usage-a1.json` and `usage-a2-3p-1970.json` (`/usage`, the second with a window not yet started: reset 1970), and `settings.json` (the permission rules System stages). Used by [antigravity.test.ts](../../antigravity.test.ts).
